verdict.rationale: Pigment documents an official MCP server page that lets external assistants such as Claude, Cursor, Codex and ChatGPT build and edit models and query business data. Admins approve which assistants connect, and access is scoped by role, model or metric. Agent Connectors, where Pigment's own agents reach out to other systems, are client-side and are not credited here. Missing for 10: technical setup documentation (endpoint, auth flow, tool list) beyond the marketing page, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.
